# simplevm_vms (Data Source)

Lists the VMs visible to the API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "simplevm_vms" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier of this data source.
- `vms` (Attributes List) The VMs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vms))

<a id="nestedatt--vms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vms`

Read-Only:

- `fixed_ip` (String) Fixed IP address.
- `flavor_name` (String) Name of the VM flavor.
- `image_name` (String) Name of the image the VM was created from.
- `name` (String) VM name.
- `state` (String) VM state, for example `active` or `stopped`.
- `task_state` (String) Current task state, empty if none.
- `uuid` (String) VM UUID.
